integrity: The all-path proof uses exact centered potential identities and positivity of their Gram matrix. Finite stress tests are corroborative and not proofs. Primary published-source comparison records its inspected extent; independent audit has not been performed.
limitations: Positive undirected weighted paths and the squared Moore–Penrose Laplacian-pseudoinverse diagonal only. Location of the maximizer, not optimization over conductance values or extension to cyclic networks. Historical priority may be incomplete.
title: Endpoint extremality of second-order vertex coherence on every weighted path
